title: The Conditions Of A Third World War Have Already Been Met | Volodymyr Yelchenko
summary: A former Ukrainian ambassador says the world already lives under third-world-war conditions, warns Russia will push further into Europe if it wins, and says Russia would have invaded regardless.

assertions.quote: We are already living under conditions of the third world war. It is simply very different from the second and the first.
he will have more uh meat for the war and he will have more potential to go further into Europe.

verdicts.note: Whether Russia would attack further after a win is a conditional prediction about intent; NATO governments warn of it but there is no record to test.
DDIS makes the Ukraine war ending or freezing the first condition for a Russian attack on NATO, after which resources flow to the build-up; it is a condition for a threat, not a prediction of attack.

assertions.quote: even if those events would not happen in Kyiv and in Ukraine, they would find something else and sooner or later they would start invasion
in some other European countries like France and Germany, like 15, 17, 20% of population only are ready to defend their country.

verdicts.note: Surveys such as Gallup's 2024 poll found only about a quarter or fewer of Germans, Italians and others say they would fight for their country.

assertions.quote: you will start spending much more money uh, to uh, uh, to defend from Russia than you can spend right now

verdicts.note: Studies such as the Kiel Institute's put aid to Ukraine at a fraction of the cost of rearming against a victorious Russia, but the estimate rests on assuming Russia would attack.

assertions.quote: during this year only Ukrainian armed forces were able to liberate more territory occupied previously by Russians than Russians were able to occupy.

verdicts.note: Open-source trackers such as ISW and DeepState show Russia gaining several thousand square kilometres in 2025 against small Ukrainian recaptures.
